name: Schema Validation
description: Payload validates against the pinned 2024-10 schema

name: Enum Validity
description: No unknown enum values (e.g. invalid restockType)

name: Uniqueness
description: Line ID and refund ID unique after ingestion

name: Idempotency
description: Re-ingestion produces zero net changes

name: Referential Integrity
description: Every refund line references an existing line item

name: Refund Quantity Bound
description: Refunded quantity does not exceed ordered quantity

name: Order Reconciliation
description: Sum of line nets plus shipping minus discounts reconciles to order total

name: Discount Allocation Sum
description: Sum of line discount allocations equals order total discount

name: Refund Subtotal Reconciliation
description: Sum of refund subtotals reconciles to total refunded

name: Currency Consistency
description: No mixed-currency sum without shopMoney conversion

name: COGS State Completeness
description: COGS state assigned to 100% of lines

name: Unknown Cost Share Reporting
description: Cost-unknown share reported per variant

name: Allocation Conservation
description: Allocated shipping and fees sum exactly to order amounts

name: Positive Allocations
description: No negative allocation unless a refund explains it

name: Deterministic Time
description: All windows and maturity use as_of, never system clock

name: Score Bounds & Margin Rule
description: Score in [0,100] or null; margin null exactly when RetainedRev <= 0

name: Waterfall Conservation
description: Waterfall sums exactly to NaiveProfit - Contribution

name: Revenue Conservation
description: Conservation: revenue_scored + revenue_quarantined = revenue_total

name: Sync Freshness
description: Last sync within freshness threshold

name: Schema Drift Introspection
description: Introspection diff against pinned version
